title: Teaching himself piano and forming a teenage band
summary: Joe figured out keys by watching Warren and Sam Morgan, then formed a small band with Sylvester Thompson, Octave Murray and a drummer.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
